newsitem.title: LATVIA: Listless Latvian share market sees low volume.
newsitem.headline: Listless Latvian share market sees low volume.

text.p: The summer seasonal bear market hit Latvian share trading on Tuesday as soaring temperatures pushed volume down, dealers said.
Overall market volume was a paltry 45,000 lats and the bourse's recently introduced index inched down 0.01 percent to 152.32. The Rietumu index closed 0.2 percent lower at 152.32.

Dealers blamed the sluggish performance partly on a sudden summer heat wave and partly on the continued popularity of government debt and privatisation vouchers, which investors are seen favouring over equities.
But dealers hope that a spate of six-month results, due out soon, will inject life into the listless market.
Three of the five official list stocks eased, one was not quoted and one held steady.
Traditional market leader Unibanka slipped 0.9 percent to 3.35 lats in trade of 11,000 lats.
On the secondary list, pharmaceutical producer Olainfarm bounced back after falling sharply on Monday, rising to 2.49 lats from 2.17 lats in trade of 12,500 lats.
Lode Brick factory also gained on the secondary list, rising to 2.21 lats from 2.16 lats in trade of 1,300 lats.
Dealers said its price has been pushed up by expectations of solid six-month results.
